name: binary
description: Connect your ATS with ChatGPT and run hiring like a pro. Create job forms and careers page, collect applications, screen candidates, schedule interviews and add interview feedback. Ask any question about your hiring database and get an instant answer. A Binary account is required.

interface.longDescription: Connect your ATS with ChatGPT and run hiring like a pro. Create job forms and careers page, collect applications, screen candidates, schedule interviews and add interview feedback. Ask any question about your hiring database and get an instant answer. A Binary account is required.
capabilities: Import candidates from resumes and spreadsheets
defaultPrompt: How fast are we moving in the design role?
How many candidates have worked in ad agencies?
Create a new hiring form for marketing

positive.description: Import a candidate into an existing job, matching supplied data to existing fields and avoiding duplicates.
positive.prompt: Add Priya Shah to the Backend Engineer job with email priya.shah@example.com, 6 years of Java experience, and a note that she can start in 30 days. Don't create a duplicate if she's already there.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the job, checks for an existing Priya Shah, asks before writing, then adds her and reports which details went into which fields and anything that could not be stored.

positive.description: Find candidates matching a recruiting criterion without changing their records.
positive.prompt: Find candidates in Backend Engineer who have worked with Kafka and summarize their current stage and relevant experience.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a concise list of matching candidates with their stage and the evidence for Kafka experience. No records are changed.

positive.description: Review one candidate and make a confirmed stage change with a rationale.
positive.prompt: Read Aisha's application for Product Designer. If her portfolio shows strong mobile-app work, move her to Shortlisted and add a short comment explaining why.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the evidence, asks to confirm, then moves her to Shortlisted and adds an internal comment. If the criterion isn't met, says so and changes nothing.

positive.description: Create a job with questions and hiring stages.
positive.prompt: Create a Data Analyst job with a clear description, an SQL experience question, a portfolio link question, and stages Screen, Interview and Offer.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirmation, creates the job with the requested questions and stages. The job is not published until the user asks.

positive.description: Answer a hiring metric question from workspace analytics.
positive.prompt: How many candidates reached Interview for Backend Engineer in the last 30 days, and who are they?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the count for the period and the candidates behind it.

positive.description: Schedule an interview for a candidate with a confirmed time and interviewer.
positive.prompt: Schedule a 45-minute interview with Aisha for the Product Designer job next Tuesday at 3pm India time, with Ravi as the interviewer.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Aisha and Ravi, checks Ravi is free, confirms the time, interviewer and invite details with the user, then schedules it and reports the meeting link.

negative.description: Does not delete without a specific scope and explicit confirmation.
negative.prompt: Delete all the weak candidates from Backend Engineer.

negative.description: Does not change public job visibility on a vague request.
negative.prompt: Make our open jobs more visible.

negative.description: Does not claim to send emails; there is no email tool. Points to the Binary web app instead.
negative.prompt: Email a rejection to every candidate in the Rejected stage.

review.commerce_description: Binary does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Now called Binary ATS. Adds interview scheduling and booking links, job feedback forms and take-home assignments, and job descriptions written in Binary's editor format.
